flashcard_questions.q: Organic compounds needed in small amounts for essential body functions such as immune health, energy release, and cell repair.
Nutrients the body needs in very small amounts — vitamins and minerals.
Vitamins that dissolve in fat and can be stored in the liver and body fat — vitamins A, D, E, and K.

flashcard_questions.a: Vitamins that dissolve in water and cannot be stored in the body, so they must be consumed regularly — B-group and C.
A fat-soluble vitamin essential for vision (especially in dim light), immune function, and healthy skin. Found as retinol in animal foods and as beta-carotene in orange and green vegetables.
